RoboMoCap

A Large-Scale Whole-Body Motion Capture Dataset with Egocentric Vision for Robot Learning

Egocentric vision. High-fidelity whole-body motion.
RoboMoCap pairs multimodal first-person observations with optical whole-body motion capture for humanoid robot learning. With six head-mounted and two wrist-mounted cameras, the dataset captures diverse locomotion and loco-manipulation behaviours… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/BitRobot/robomocap.
